label: Pre-eclampsia
summary: A bounded pre-eclampsia map: defective placentation and placental ischaemia/oxidative stress, the antiangiogenic sFlt-1/soluble endoglin/PlGF axis, maternal endothelial dysfunction with renal, hepatic and cerebral end-organ outcomes, and immune/complement/AT1 autoantibody contributions. Chronic hypertension without pre-eclampsia, gestational hypertension alone, postpartum-onset disease, screening performance and therapy efficacy are out of scope.
